nodes.text: with whomever anyone drank of it,
that one he had to, against his will,
and that one him alone in return.
To them were a death and a life,
a sorrow and a joy given together.
The wise woman took the drink;
for she was beautiful and was also a maiden.
is as wind-blown as a sleeve.
wherever one knows how to press him,
as by every right he should.
He is ready for all hearts,
Be it earnest, be it play,
he is always however one wishes.
so that she came away with her honour.
